name: Heartbeat
summary: Gives each of your jobs a check-in URL and alerts a webhook when a check-in is missed.
description: Create a check for each cron job or backup with how often it should check in and how much grace it gets. Your job calls the check's secret URL after each run; when a check-in is missed you get one alert, and one message when it checks in again. Works with Slack, Discord, Telegram or any webhook URL.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py heartbeat.py && mkdir -p dist && cp main.py heartbeat.py index.html dist/

settings.name: CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS
settings.description: How often overdue checks are looked for (5 to 3600 seconds)

secrets.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
secrets.description: Password for the check list at the app's address: at least 16 random characters. Without it checks cannot be created or listed (existing check-in URLs keep working)

secrets.name: WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: Where alerts are sent: a Slack, Discord or Telegram webhook URL, or any URL that accepts a JSON POST. Empty: alerts only appear in the log
